start.text: Kindleby's skiff lies drawn up on the shingle, Hild's oars across the thwarts and her lantern lit in the bow.

choice.text: Ask Hild to row you back to Kindleby.

back.text: Iver gets in after you without being asked and sits in the stern with his hands in his lap. He doesn't look back at the light once.
Good. In you get. Eyes on the ember, ears to yourself.
